description.value: Kinton Ramen is a Canadian ramen chain founded in 2012 by executive chef Aki Urata, now operating 50+ locations across Canada and the US. The menu spans pork, beef, chicken, and vegetarian broths with multiple flavour and noodle options, and guests are greeted with the traditional Japanese welcome 'Irasshaimase.' A Sunwood Coquitlam location appears to have recently opened, suggesting active expansion in the Lower Mainland.
